description: Offers a site to a new Site Owner by email; they accept and pick where it lives. recipient: what the site needs beyond Free, same for any address. The sender's bill doesn't change. Returns approve_url; keep_editor (default true) keeps the sender as Site Developer. A workspace site: its Site Owner sends to themselves or someone in it.

confirm_token.description: From the first call: approval status

email.description: The new Site Owner's email (required unless confirm_token)
